selection_criterion: max Avg Profit s.t. Fill Rate >= 0.9

newsvendor_critical_ratio.formula: Cu/(Cu+Co), Cu=unit_revenue-unit_cost+p, Co=unit_cost+h+w (profit-optimal for the stated objective)

selection_basis: last CV validation fold; selector calibrator, EmpNV residuals, and policy history statistics use data strictly before that fold
residual_distribution_source: cv_fold_validation residuals of the calibrated ensemble, cross-fitted (calibrator for fold f fit on folds < f); out-of-sample w.r.t. model training; recovery and FeatureBuilder are refit through each fold origin
note: profit is an observed-sales proxy under censored evaluation; direction of bias vs latent-demand profit is not identified
